blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: Most Hanover Park homeowners replace like for like, a 40- or 50-gallon gas tank, because it's the simplest swap. But a replacement is also the best time to rethink. A larger tank or a high-recovery model helps a busy household. A power-vent unit solves some venting problems. A tankless heater frees up floor space and doesn't run out. We'll walk through what each one means for your space, your venting and your gas line before you decide.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of a New Water Heater
blocks.body: Tank size and fuel type come first. Power-vent models cost more than standard ones. An expansion tank or venting changes may be needed to meet code. Access to the utility room matters too. We check everything and quote one flat price.

items.answer: Most homes use 40 or 50 gallons. Larger families may need more.

items.q: Do I need an expansion tank?
